title: Sticker CTA: one tilted white sticker word with a heavy black outline and an offset black plate, invented pseudo-glyphs under it, an acid flash, on grey with a stripe corner
use: The loudest call to action of a first screen or a download banner. One per screen.

tilt.note: sticker tilt, degrees clockwise (the board's is about 8)

film.note: film strip in the stripe corner

relations: Sticker tilted 5-9 degrees clockwise; outline 12 units; offset plate 9 x 11 units down-right.
The pseudo-glyph line is decoration, never readable copy; the real platforms line sits level on the grey.
decoration: Pseudo-glyphs, stripe corner, film strip: drawn.

provenance.corpus: replay-ward case (回放街区 REPLAY WARD): our own original one-page game site and two in-game screens in the street-tape grammar
provenance.experiment: styles/street-tape/style.json provenance (reference board measured privately; never shipped)
provenance.method: The case's first-screen download sticker (372 x 190 at 1920) set on its own banner.
measured: Board: the download sticker tilts about +8 degrees with a black outline and an unreadable subtitle.
Case: 0 findings; the subtitle is drawn bars, so no glyph or contrast rule reads it as text.
